name: Гриб
alt: Фиолетовый гриб-богатырь гордо тренируется с нелепо маленькой деревянной гантелью.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384 by 384 pixels. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated character colors, simple chunky shapes, a strong readable silhouette and one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery. Modest detail appropriate for a small card. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or separate panels. Do not imitate an existing copyrighted card illustration. Clear plausible anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: A squat grouchy mushroom monster with one enormous bright purple cap dotted with cream spots, a thick ivory stalk body, exactly two stubby arms and two root-like feet. One hand angrily holds an outrageously small wooden dumbbell, the other rests on its hip. Puffed cheeks and an absurdly proud bodybuilding pose, scattered tiny ordinary mushrooms accentuate its size. No extra limbs, no text.
